per_candidate.id: s2:Radio Observations of Coronal Mass Ejection Initiation and Development in the Lo

rationale: The papers 2008.04380, 2101.02181, 2004.03790, and 2010.10186 investigate aspects of the formation and evolution of magnetic flux ropes and their relation to solar eruptions, contributing evidence relevant to the nature of dormant phenomena prior to eruptions.
